# Vendored Markdown tree utilities

`model.ts`, `markdown.ts`, and `merge.ts` are copied from the MIT-licensed gogoga Mind Map source held in the local `personal-mindmap/vendor/gogoga` project (version 0.34.0).

Copyright (c) 2026 JackWei. The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE` in this directory. These files provide Markdown parsing, tree primitives, and format-preserving serialization; the Markdown Tool adapter, history, persistence, and UI are maintained separately.
